description: Sends the signing invitation again to every signatory and validator of a signature request that is ACTIVE, PARTIALLY_SIGNED or REJECTED (observers are not messaged again) and clears their bounced-email flag. Use it after fixing a bounced or mistyped email with signature_participant_update, or when a signer lost the invitation. This messages real people: confirm with your user before calling it. Requires: case_file_create → caseFileId, signature_request_create → requestId. Returns no body.
name: signature_request_resend
